questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Bolivia?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter A and has 9 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Bolivia article.

questions.proof: It is landlocked by Brazil, Paraguay, Argentina, Peru, and Chile.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Bolivia?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter S and has 7 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Bolivia article.

questions.proof: The main languages are Spanish and Quechua, but there are other languages too.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “It is around the same size as _____.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter M and has 10 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the Bolivia article.

questions.proof: It is around the same size as Mauritania.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “This makes Bolivia the world's 28th-largest country (after _____).”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter E and has 8 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the Bolivia article.

questions.proof: This makes Bolivia the world's 28th-largest country (after Ethiopia).

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “After many wars, Simón Bolívar helped Bolivia to gain its independence in _____.”
